content: Game drops! Minecraft Dungeons II! Big news! More! Minecraft LIVE is back! Watch the community pre-show then learn about everything happening in the wide world of Minecraft in this jam-packed Minecraft LIVE! New game drops, developer insights, Minecraft Dungeons II, and some extra special announcements – it’s all coming up! Once it’s over, stick around for the Deep Dig After Show where our developers and guests delve deeper into some of the new features. Tune in on September 26th at 10am PT / 1pm ET / 6pm BST / 7pm CEST. American Sign Language: https://youtube.com/live/vKkn3Xz9GlM British Sign Language: https://youtube.com/live/HzvQddPcsTc Audio Descriptions: https://youtube.com/live/536FOix4xE4 Get Minecraft Dungeons II at: https://www.minecraft.net/store/minecraft-dungeons-ii-deluxe-edition Check out Minecraft.net for more information! https://www.minecraft.net/
